metadata.description: Qwen multimodal understanding plugins — Agent Skills + MCP servers

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-core
plugins.description: Core: Read and visualize any file — images, video, documents, code, data, 3D models, NIfTI volumes, and more. Includes media metadata, image cropping, bounding-box annotation, and page/frame export as MCP tools.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-api
plugins.description: API: Understand images, video, and audio through VL/Omni models, Qwen3-ASR, and SAM3. Provides vision chat, OCR, object grounding, transcription, speaker diarization, timestamped captions, event analysis, and segmentation as MCP tools, using hosted or self-hosted model services.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-search
plugins.description: Web search and page extraction via Serper, Exa, or Tavily, plus Serper Lens reverse-image search as MCP tools.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-video-memory
plugins.description: Hierarchical graph memory for long-video QA (build + query) as an MCP server.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-omni-memory
plugins.description: Long-video audio-visual memory (build + query) as an MCP server.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-video-edit
plugins.description: ffmpeg-based video-editing workflows (skill) + image/video/audio generation as MCP tools.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-edu-agent
plugins.description: Educational tutorial-video generator (skill only): turn a math/science problem or image into a step-by-step Chinese explainer video or interactive page.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-blender
plugins.description: Blender 3D modeling: drive a live Blender (execute Python, screenshot the viewport, PolyHaven/Sketchfab/Hyper3D/Hunyuan3D assets) as MCP tools + a build→refine→verify skill. Needs a running Blender + addon.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-freecad
plugins.description: FreeCAD parametric CAD: create/edit objects, execute Python, named-view screenshots, parts library, and CalculiX FEM as MCP tools + a skill. Needs a running FreeCAD + addon.
